outcome: HBV mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) rate (measured by HBsAg-positive infants)
Serious adverse events in mothers and infants
cohort: The study included 644 Hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg)-positive pregnant women with high HBV DNA load (>=2 X 10^5 IU/mL) and their infants.
finding: Both telbivudine (TBV) and tenofovir (TDF) effectively reduced maternal HBV DNA levels and mother-to-child transmission rates, and were safe for mothers and infants, with TDF being more effective in reducing HBV DNA levels when initiated in the second trimester.
